title: K-flat invertibility of the actual scalar representative
statement: For commutative rings A,B, phi:A→B, a scheme T and a K-flat cochain complex C of A-module sheaves, the actual chosen-adjoint scalar representative at C [def-sp-coefficient-scalar-representatives] is invertible. No flatness of phi, boundedness or finiteness is assumed.

source.place: Step 2: finite reduction is derived scalar tensor and its compatibility with invertible twists follows from derived tensor associativity; Stacks Tags 07A4 and 0FPT.

proof.text: Apply the proved exact-right-derived-adjoint K-flat comparison to ordinary scalar extension and exact restriction. Scalar extension preserves K-flat quasi-isomorphisms. Restriction preserves finite limits by its scalar adjunction and finite colimits by its coextension adjunction. Identify the mapped ordinary unit with the cochain adjunction unit degree by degree, then substitute into that comparison.
